items.title: Mrs. Robert George (Mary) Hoffman Interview, 1976-02-05
items.q: Don Philippine? Don Philippine. [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. [INTERVIEWEE] Don Philippine. Yeah. [INTERVIEWER] And he left town.

ctx.x: I forget all the different things he did.

I don't even, let's see if there's anything in this one about... No, this is an article I wrote for it. Oh. Why noise and noise and organist. That was one of the greatest, uh, uh, troubles that we ever had, people who played the organ. Uh, young people would come in and, you know, and they'd all get cutting up and making noise and everything. Yeah. Maybe you'd be playing some beautiful, sad something and there would noise. So I wrote that. I don't even remember what it said. I haven't looked at it for a long…
